PhaseLadderRow.description: One phase row of `gates/ladder.json`'s `phases` array, plan §6.

blocked_by.description: The earlier unmet phase id blocking this one, when state is OUT_OF_ORDER; null otherwise.
blocked_by.title: Blocked By

clauses_met.description: null when the phase has never been graded at all (no registered gate).
clauses_met.title: Clauses Met

clauses_unmeasurable.description: Count of this phase's clauses that read UNMEASURABLE (a store access failure, distinct from a clause that was read and found unmet). null exactly where clauses_total is null (no registered gate).
clauses_unmeasurable.title: Clauses Unmeasurable

decision_id.description: `console-policy` §2.1: the identifier IS the tracker ref, so a `git-host` claim about the same issue merges onto this row.
decision_id.title: Decision Id

gate.description: The registered gate name, or null when no gate has been written for this phase yet.
gate.title: Gate

met_ratio.description: null when nothing was measured (no clauses). Never 0.0 for an unmeasured reading -- 0.0 is a real measurement of zero clauses met out of a nonzero total (principle 7, I9824).
met_ratio.title: Met Ratio

read_on.description: The last trading day this gate was read, or null when never.
read_on.title: Read On

state.description: crucible.gate.LADDER_STATES: MET | UNMET | UNMEASURED | UNMEASURABLE | OUT_OF_ORDER. Closed set.
state.title: State

PhaseLadderRow.title: PhaseLadderRow

description: The record at gates/ladder.json, produced by crucible.gate.build_ladder/ladder_payload and published by exactly ONE writer: crucible gate --publish / crucible gate.close (crucible/track_f.py::gate_handler). crucible console was a second publisher until I10575 and re-evaluated every gate under its own environment, republishing a false phase0 UNMEASURABLE ladder over the gate publisher's phase2 reading; it now READS this key and embeds it. Versioned because the fleet console reads this key through an s3-records adapter, a cross-repo consumer; additionalProperties: false because a field this reader does not understand is a field the producer expected it to act on (I9825).

current_phase.description: The lowest phase whose gate is not met, or `complete`. Not the highest phase with work in it.
current_phase.title: Current Phase

out_of_order.description: Phase ids currently graded ahead of an earlier unmet phase.
out_of_order.title: Out Of Order

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema. A consumer that cannot read the version refuses the document rather than guessing.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

trading_day.description: The NYSE trading day the ladder was built for (§4.12). Never a wall-clock date.
trading_day.title: Trading Day

unmeasured.description: Count of rows whose gate_state is UNMEASURED. Published rather than left for a reader to derive.
unmeasured.title: Unmeasured

title: Crucible plan §6 phase ladder, v1
